# PromptReel — AI Video Prompt Generator

> PromptReel is a free ($0) tool that turns a rough idea into a structured, ready-to-paste prompt for AI video models. No sign-up. Everything runs in the browser; user text is not uploaded or stored.

## Pricing
- Price: $0 free. All generators included. No paid plan is required.
- Details: https://mazhouyi0-hub.github.io/ai-video-prompt-generator/pricing/

## Tools
- AI Video Prompt Generator: https://mazhouyi0-hub.github.io/ai-video-prompt-generator/
- Veo 3 Prompt Generator (text + JSON): https://mazhouyi0-hub.github.io/ai-video-prompt-generator/veo-3-prompt-generator/
- Sora 2 Prompt Generator: https://mazhouyi0-hub.github.io/ai-video-prompt-generator/sora-2-prompt-generator/
